note: Field-isolated evidence only. Assignment counts are NOT used as capability proof.

facts: Oracle Fusion as financial system of record
infra_systems_technology.draftValue: Systems model is operator-owned and brand-agnostic at the data layer: PMS, channel managers, CRS, revenue management, POS, labour/payroll, and Oracle Fusion financials ingest into Microsoft Fabric as Highgate’s unified source of truth (Highgate Intelligence).
infra_systems_technology.whyBelongs: Names the actual systems architecture and data foundation—not a brand list.
infra_systems_technology.exemplarAlignment: Comparable to HE systems map (named stack classes)

facts: IBM Planning & Analytics for owner/auditor/lender reporting
Owner packages tailored by ownership structure with analyst-reviewed AI commentary
infra_asset_management_reporting.draftValue: Owner/asset reporting runs through Highgate Intelligence: IBM Planning & Analytics produces multidimensional budgeting, forecasting, and audit-ready packages for owners, auditors, and lenders; portfolio flash covers occupancy/ADR/RevPAR/flow-through before the first meeting; owner packs are tailored by ownership structure (REIT, fund, private) with analyst-reviewed commentary.
infra_asset_management_reporting.whyBelongs: Documents reporting mechanisms and cadence artifacts—not generic ‘transparent reporting’.
infra_asset_management_reporting.exemplarAlignment: Matches HE weekly/monthly/quarterly specificity bar via named tools + package types

facts: Owner intelligence positioned as continuous insight not monthly-only packages
ownerEngagementNarrative.draftValue: Highgate engages ownership through an institutional reporting interface (Highgate Intelligence) rather than monthly packages alone—owners receive audit-ready financials via IBM Planning & Analytics plus continuous portfolio flash and variance narratives reviewed by analysts.
ownerEngagementNarrative.whyBelongs: Describes the owner interaction surface (reporting interface + analyst review), not ops SOPs.
ownerEngagementNarrative.exemplarAlignment: Owner-alignment framing like HE, with named mechanism

facts: Segment-focused business units with dedicated support teams

cap_profile_operational.draftValue: Operations are organized as focused business units by segment (lifestyle & luxury / boutique, Caribbean & Latin America resort, full- and select-service urban branded) each with dedicated support teams, rather than a single undifferentiated ops pool (highgate.com capabilities).

facts: Robust sales platform cited on capabilities page
cap_profile_commercial.draftValue: Commercial engine includes proprietary demand and air-passenger traffic forecasting feeding visitation intelligence, supported by a dedicated sales platform used to drive bookings across the managed portfolio (Highgate capabilities).

AI resort expansion via Sirenis alliance
cap_profile_commercial.draftValue: Public materials and trade coverage describe OxoHotel as providing commercial strategy and revenue management alongside operations, with an all-inclusive growth push via alliances (e.g. Grupo Sirenis) while also operating major international brands in Colombia.

infra_systems_technology.whyBelongs: Explicit brand-dependent systems posture with named platform (MxM/Marriott).

facts: customized sales approach with owner/GM/area team
ownerEngagementNarrative.draftValue: MxM owner engagement is framed as a brand-managed partnership: above-property MxM sales, marketing, revenue, finance, and HR teams work with the owner and GM; case studies describe owner–GM–Area Team customization of the sales model rather than a published third-party owner portal.
ownerEngagementNarrative.whyBelongs: Owner interaction model under brand management.

facts: talent pipeline ~90% GMs grew at MxM
cap_profile_operational.draftValue: MxM delivers turnkey brand-managed operations with deep Marriott talent pipelines (MxM cites ~90% of GMs grew careers at MxM hotels) and above-property operational support plugged into the Marriott system—ops accountability is brand-operator, not independent third-party.
cap_profile_operational.whyBelongs: How day-to-day ops are organized under MxM.

cap_profile_commercial.draftValue: MxM commercial model centers on synergy across Sales, Revenue Management, and Marketing executing hotel revenue strategy with Marriott RM tools; MxM separates sales from on-property service so property teams focus on guests while above-property/area sales capture leads, with owner-approved customization when needed.

facts: Case study: months of pre-transition budget review
cap_profile_transition.draftValue: MxM documents transition readiness in case studies: above-property teams begin months before takeover to review budgets and opportunities, then plug the hotel into MxM sales/marketing/RM and fill vacancies via Marriott’s talent pipeline for a managed cutover.

Hilton Systems Solutions / HITS for brand system
infra_systems_technology.draftValue: Systems model is Hilton brand-platform dependent: managed hotels participate in Hilton’s centralized reservations, internet/technology, marketing, and quality-assurance programs (owner program fees); Hilton Systems Solutions / HITS agreements govern brand IT—do not assume an independent operator stack.

ownerEngagementNarrative.draftValue: Under Hilton management agreements, Hilton operates for the owner with managerial discretion typically subject to owner approval of annual operating and capital budgets and certain key personnel; fees generally include base management fees on revenue and, when applicable, incentive fees on operating profits (Hilton filings).

facts: Hilton operates hotels under management contracts
cap_profile_operational.draftValue: Hilton managed ops: Hilton (or affiliates) operate the hotel under a management contract for third-party owners, providing on-property leadership and brand operating systems; in many jurisdictions Hilton employs property associates directly (Hilton filings).

facts: Program fees fund advertising/marketing, reservations, QA
cap_profile_commercial.draftValue: Commercial distribution for Hilton-managed hotels is brand-system led: owners fund advertising/marketing, reservations/technology, and quality-assurance programs via monthly program fees, and participate in Hilton Honors—commercial lift is primarily Hilton system scale rather than an independent operator saleshouse.
